sehemu: Part III: The Prime Minister, the Cabinet and the Government
maudhui: There shall be a Secretary to the Cabinet who shall be the chief executive officer in the Office of the Cabinet and who shall, in accordance with the directions of the President, perform the following functions: (a) prepare the programme of Cabinet meetings and the agenda for each meeting; (b) record and keep the minutes of Cabinet meetings; (c) communicate and explain Cabinet decisions to every person or public institution concerned with any such decision; and (d) perform such other duties and functions as the President may from time to time direct.
